title: Klarna takes off with Corendon Airlines, bringing flexible payments to passengers in seven European markets | Klarna International
body_markdown:
**New York - November 24, 2026 -** Klarna, the everyday finance network, announced today a new partnership with Corendon Airlines, the airline of firsts. Klarna is now live at checkout on the Corendon Airlines website for passengers in Germany, the Netherlands, Austria, Belgium, Switzerland, Poland and the UK, and additional markets will follow.


With Klarna, passengers can choose to pay in full, in 30 days, in three interest-free installments, or through financing (availability varies by market).


“Corendon Airlines and Klarna share the same goal: making travel easy and transparent from the very first click. Booking a holiday is a big moment, and it should come with clear choices. With Klarna at checkout, passengers can see exactly what they’ll pay and when, because booking a flight should be as smooth as the journey itself,” said Nicole Defren, Head of Europe at Klarna.


“We continue to develop our digital solutions to make travel easier, more flexible and more user-focused at every stage of the booking process,” said Erkan Erbay, CFO of Corendon Airlines. “By adding Klarna, we give passengers payment options suited to their different needs, and they can conveniently track their orders in one place through the Klarna app. Following the launch on our website, we aim to bring Klarna to our mobile app to further enhance our passengers’ digital travel experience.”


With 170 city across 45 country, Corendon Airlines’ network combined with Klarna’s flexible payment options makes travel more accessible, just in time for winter sun getaways and early bookings for summer 2027.


**About Klarna**
Klarna is the everyday finance network. With over 122 million global active Klarna users and 3.8 million transactions per day, Klarna’s AI-powered payments and commerce network is empowering people to pay smarter with a mission to be available everywhere for everything. Consumers can pay with Klarna online, in-store and through Apple Pay & Google Pay. Over 1.35 million retailers trust Klarna’s innovative solutions to drive growth and loyalty, including Uber, H&M, Saks, Sephora, Macy’s, Ikea, Expedia Group, Nike and Airbnb. Klarna is listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: KLAR). For more information, visit


[Klarna.com](https://www.klarna.com/)
